contention.stimulus: Test-only one-time Signal/Yield at active batch admission, before enumeration; peer already owns its DOS context. Queue timing starts at its ordinary PutMsg. No per-entry hooks; production worker unchanged.

limitations: Three warm repetitions are throughput evidence, not p95 qualification.
First SYS:C visit misses two directory sectors after prior boot/root use; not a fully cold cache.
Parent and capacity-16 use the capacity-8 SYS disk from boot. Version-matched standalone apps are on a separate WORK disk.
RAM contains the same two names but build-specific embedded Desktop payloads.
GUI-launched background LIST finished before scan; its sample is excluded from competing-client claims. Controlled active-batch peer test compares capacities 8/16 instead.
Root eight-entry scan includes 3.70 ms of presenter work; some RAM samples also include a presenter turn. CPU charges are retained, not subtracted.

Selector Escape is injected with a live scan lock; this does not prove an active ExNextBatch packet or bound cancellation at every phase. One sample per build; no physical traffic during these cancellation intervals.
